title: A Current for the Provision
premise: Xanthe Amberdale, a debt-burdened storm chaser living off the grid, is hired by a desperate government liaison to retrace the route of a vanished survey team in the Kestrel River basin. Following the river upstream, he finds the team's gear arranged with eerie deliberateness and learns they were silenced by the Calder Company, which secretly controls the river's source and the water rights of an entire valley. Xanthe must choose between staying invisible and carrying the evidence out before the dry season closes the passes. In the end he exposes the source's existence to the valley settlers at the cost of his own anonymity, paying his debts not in money but in truth.
about_author: Orsen Dunmore is the pen name of a former hydrological surveyor who spent six seasons mapping remote river systems before walking away from the industry. He now writes adventure fiction from a cabin with no road access, drawing on the landscapes and moral compromises he witnessed firsthand.

chapters.title: The Debt of Clear Skies
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. Broke and hunted by the 'optimists' who financed his storm-chasing rig, Xanthe accepts a lucrative but off-the-books job: find out what happened to a government survey team that vanished near the Kestrel headwaters. The emotional beat is reluctant commitment—he wants no part of heroics, only survival, yet the missing team includes a woman who once saved his life.

chapters.title: Gear Without Tracks
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV, intercut with journal fragments from the survey leader. He discovers the camp intact—food cached, instruments running—but no bodies and no tracks, as if the team walked into the river itself. The beat is dread deepening into obsession as he realizes the arrangement was deliberate, a message meant for whoever came looking.

chapters.title: What the Source Keeps
chapters.summary: Alternating POV between Xanthe and a Calder Company warden hunting him. Upstream, Xanthe finds the survey team alive but imprisoned at a hidden dam—the river's true source, seized illegally by Calder to control the valley's water. The beat is fury and clarity: justice here exists outside any courtroom, and Xanthe must decide whose side the current carries.

chapters.title: Dry Season
chapters.summary: Xanthe's POV. With the passes closing, he frees the team and floods Calder's records downstream to the valley settlers, sacrificing his invisibility forever. The warden dies by the river's own indifference; the optimists' debt is settled with the bounty on Calder's secret. The beat is hard-won peace—Xanthe remains a wanted man, but an honest one, watching the water run free.
